sentences.ar: رحنا عالدكان وهولمز دق عالبلاط بعصايته.
sentences.en: We went to the shop and Holmes tapped the pavement with his stick.

sentences.ar: وبعدين لف عالشارع اللي ورا ولقى بنك.
sentences.en: And then he went round to the street behind and found a bank.

sentences.ar: قال: القبو اللي بيصور فيه بيمشي بهالاتجاه.
sentences.en: He said: the cellar he photographs in runs in that direction.
And the knees of his trousers were dusty and worn.

sentences.ar: بالليل، قعدنا بالعتمة بقبو البنك ننتظر.
sentences.en: At night, we sat in the dark in the bank cellar and waited.

sentences.ar: طلعت إيد من بين حجرتين بالأرض.
sentences.en: A hand came up between two stones in the floor.

sentences.ar: لستراد مسكه، وهولمز قال: العصبة كانت لتشغلك بس.
sentences.en: Lestrade seized him, and Holmes said: the league was only to keep you busy.
